POST /language/resolve.userOnly: The editor starts and drives a Python language service session using the cursor position as the user types.

POST /projects/{project_id}/activate.userOnly: This selects the project shown in the workbench. AI actions identify projects by ID.

POST /projects/{project_id}/debug.userOnly: The desktop opens VS Code or starts an interactive debugging session in the user's IDE.

POST /projects/{project_id}/vscode.userOnly: The desktop opens VS Code or starts an interactive debugging session in the user's IDE.

WS /language/sessions/{session}.userOnly: The editor starts and drives a Python language service session using the cursor position as the user types.
